items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: No, oh I can't think of his name, another saxophone player that was with Basie.

ctx.x: Did that strike you right away that he was, what he was doing was a little different?
No. Because after hearing all my boys with the Basie Band -- shucks!
Nobody really made your eyes open that wide, not after Prez.
